rationale: uswin-claude-agentic: train_n=480, val_n=214, epochs=26, batch_size=4, lr=0.0005, uswin_c=24, swin_window=8, swin_heads=4, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=980, seed=42, rationale=ITER-5 (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol). START FROM iter-3 BEST (c24/ep64), NOT iter-4's c32. ONE KNOB: TRAINING DATA train_n 200 -> 480 (2.4x), with epochs TRADED DOWN 64 -> 26 to fit the HARD 20-min (1200s) train+score wall. uswin_c reverts 32 -> 24 (iter-3 best), all else identical to iter-3 (val_n=214, bs=4, lr=5e-4, swin_window=8, swin_heads=4, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS). (1) iter-3 BEST: SSIM 0.924443 / hr 0.353196 / PSNR 37.86 in elapsed_s=1085.87, train_n=200, c24, ep64 (#2 on the Mayo board). iter-4 (c32/ep34) REGRESSED to hr 0.272533 (SSIM 0.892773) in 760.76s -> the capacity-for-epochs trade FAILED: ep34 under-trained the 6.9M-param c32 net more than the added capacity helped (iter-4's own falsifier (b): revert to c24 and treat 0.3532 as ceiling UNLESS an untried lever exists). (2) LIMITER: epochs are WALL-LOCKED (iter-3 ep64 used 1085.87s = 90.5pct of 1200s; ep72 would bust) AND show diminishing returns (+0.149 hr over ep10->40 but only +0.031 over ep40->64); capacity REGRESSED (iter-4). The ONE untried lever is DATA-COVERAGE: iter-3 trained on a FIXED stratified subset of train_n=200 / 579-slice pool = 34.5pct coverage. CRUCIAL MECHANISM CHECK: solver_uswin.py does NOT use RotatingSubsetDataset -- build_dataset calls load_val_split once for a FIXED train_n set, and the epoch loop does perm=torch.randperm(cfg['train_n']) over the SAME samples every epoch (no set_epoch rotation). So train_n IS a live lever (NOT inert): raising it loads strictly more DISTINCT slices the model sees every epoch. load_val_split round-robins across the 3 Mayo ps-groups (patients: 0.66192->154, 0.73979->98, 0.77873->327; pool=579), so train_n=480 spans all 3 patients (82.9pct coverage) -> better generalisation to held-out val patient L277. uswin is data-coverage-limited at train_n=200. (3) ONE KNOB: train_n 200->480 (epochs 64->26 is a forced budget-trade, not a second free knob; c reverts to iter-3's 24). BUDGET-TRADE MATH (worst-case-sized): iter-3 exact calibration (validated to the second): per_epoch_200 = (1085.87-737.72)/(64-40) = 14.51 s/epoch at train_n=200 -> per_sample_epoch = 14.51/200 = 0.07255 s; fixed (data load + 214-slice per-sample val + figure I/O, train_n-independent since val is fixed at 214) = 157.3s. At train_n=480 per_epoch = 480*0.07255 = 34.82 s/epoch. WORST CASE (+10pct/sample variance, +5pct fixed): ep26 worst elapsed = 165.2 + 26*480*0.07981 = 1161s = 19.4 min (39s margin inside 1200s); ep28 worst = 1238s BUSTS -> ep26 is the LARGEST epoch count guaranteed to fit even the worst case. REALISTIC: ep26 = 157.3 + 26*34.82 = 1063s = 17.7 min (comfortable). Train-only worst = 26*480*0.07981 = 996s; max_train_s=980 set as the HARD train-only backstop so even at hot per-sample cost train halts <=980s leaving >=220s for the worst-case 214-slice val+figure inside the 1200s budget. (4) HYPOTHESIS: more training data (200->480 distinct slices spanning all 3 train patients) lifts hr above the iter-3 0.353196, because uswin's hr flattened with epochs (training-basin at 200 samples) AND regressed with capacity (iter-4) -- the remaining slack is GENERALISATION to the unseen val patient, which broader patient coverage addresses. Predicted iter-5 hr ~0.37-0.40. FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr <= 0.353196 at train_n=480/ep26, uswin is at its budget-constrained ceiling (~0.35) on this val set and ALL three levers (epochs, capacity, data) are exhausted -> iter-6 reverts to the iter-3 c24/ep64/train_n=200 config and accepts 0.3532 as the uswin Mayo ceiling. (5) HARD 20-min train+score budget; val_n=214 = ALL L277 slices (NOT reduced); grad_clip=1.0 retained (mandatory; the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint amplifies gradients). HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps FBP, bg_target=truth, metric=321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; no fov= override). (6) no control return.
